title: A DFA with five states, a language with three classes
notes: This DFA for words ending in ab has two states it does not need. The classes do not care how the language was given: they come out the same three, so the minimal DFA has three states.
ops: start q0; accept q2; q0 a -> q1; q0 b -> q3; q1 a -> q4; q1 b -> q2; q2 a -> q1; q2 b -> q3; q3 a -> q1; q3 b -> q0; q4 a -> q1; q4 b -> q2
